vb_textbox.text: I found that sometimes there was a run on which side (left or right) that had a high yield of mushrooms. I also found that at times there was a link between the pink and purple gnomes and the green and brown gnomes. I usually kept clicking on either the same side or similar colour group if I found a high number of mushrooms and changed it up if I started getting a lower number. It's also important to click the space bar to put the mushrooms in the basket. Sometimes I forgot and got timed out.
